policy: A linked page, report, spreadsheet or tool description is a source record, not automatically an independently sampled game cohort, authentic purchase ledger or external model validation.

families.observed_population: currently priced US Indie-tagged games first listed 2020–2022 with at least 100 reviews during year one
families.independence: one underlying selected game set; update-month measurement and long-tail analysis are separate estimates over overlapping records
families.notes: Two publisher-authored September reports reuse one selected 1,312-game roster and review histories. Article-specific post-month contributor counts remain 375 vs 311, not independently reconciled.

families.observed_population: selected currently paid positive-derived-first-week-revenue model rows; excludes unmeasurable and zero-estimated games
families.independence: one provider-derived panel and companion analysis, not two samples of authentic paid orders
families.notes: Hugging Face public panel and provider's report share the 10,403-row estimated outcome; provider methodology additionally mentions a separate 32,106-row training corpus and is not asserted to be identical.

families.observed_population: GameDiscoverCo's provider-modeled lifetime gross outcomes for the January 2026 Steam release-month cohort
families.independence: one vendor release-month model disclosed in a newsletter and linked spreadsheet, not independent validation
families.notes: Publisher directly links entire January cohort chart to its Google Sheet. The source describes vendor-model results, not merchant-reconciled bank receipts.

families.observed_population: four selected opt-in operator-verified Steam financial reporting windows, separate from site's modelled lifetime Indie Focus estimates
families.independence: the revenue benchmark and verified leaderboard reuse four public operator-labelled game reporting histories and are not independent source attestations
families.notes: Dynamic site displays opt-in short windows with incomplete reporting spans; neither page supplies audited merchant data to this project or a representative paid launch cohort.

families.observed_population: one same-author same-title voluntarily reported Steam game, first 24-hour milestone and later December cumulative post
families.independence: one underlying self-selected game with two successive postmortems, not two independent games or representative release cohorts
families.notes: Early milestone exceeded 100 units, later report claims 10,525 cumulative units and clarifies accounting stage of earlier 16.5k net label. Both from one author and one AppID; no private financial statements were authenticated.

families.observed_population: One vendor's similarly titled Q1 2026 modeled Steam revenue reports, with incompatible January-to-April release eligibility counts
families.independence: two differently framed public versions from Games-Stats, not independent sampling or proof they share an identical release roster
families.notes: Operator Patreon states 7,478 Jan1-Apr16 releases and approx 110k average/650m total. Operator website says 6,169 Jan1-Apr22 and approx 120k average/733m total. Earlier larger cohort and Patreon mean-total discrepancy require missing crosswalk and original model data; do not pool them.

families.observed_population: one self-reporting game's uneven-calendar-spaced cumulative Steam sales and wishlist stock updates around a discount
families.independence: Five same-team public posts share one underlying game and changing cumulative counts; none is an independent release sample or authenticated Steam financial ledger.
families.notes: Cumulative period differences are 4/62/15 units over 9/5/7 calendar days between publication dates, with a 75-percent price promotion, community content, press, creator and curator confounds. No causal discount revenue identified.

related_documents_not_independent_replic.notes: This article samples 4,209 low-first-year-review survivors out of a broader 12,961-currently-priced roster; it is not the same 1,312 higher-review games.
Methodology refers to 32,106 training/validation records and 6,422 held-out records, not an asserted one-to-one match with the 10,403 lever panel.
Operator methodology explains the same financial service, reporting labels and estimation formulas; a methods page is not a second merchant cohort.
Valve storefront is independent evidence of public game identity and September 2025 release but does not independently attest either author financial disclosure.

October revival report uses 1651 currently paid US Indie 2020-22 games with ≥100 year-one reviews, versus an earlier 1312-game September update panel. Missing AppID join means neither identical cohort nor independent replication should be inferred.
The Steam store confirms app identity, self-publisher label and dated release, but no developer claim about cumulative sold copies or channel-dependent remittance.
